change: Add a Which is longer mode to the arrow workshop

mutations.name: the dot product pairs the wrong parts
the call is made from the x-parts alone
mutations.find:
// 1 u + v longer, 0 the same, −1 u − v longer
  truth(i){ return Math.sign(this.dot(i)); },
mutations.replace:
// 1 u + v longer, 0 the same, −1 u − v longer
  truth(i){ return Math.sign(this.Q(i).a*this.Q(i).c); },

mutations.name: u − v keeps a plus in its y-part
opposite pulls are not looked for
a negative part loses its brackets
the diagonals are drawn before the round is right
u − v is drawn from the origin
a call still moves once the round is right
